{{Quote|Get in. Let's go.|Krix|<ref name="WookHunt" />}}
'''Krix''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]] who served a Trandoshan-exclusive [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|guild]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]
during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Led by [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]], the guild captured [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] prey to hunt for sport on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Krix piloted the guild's [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where the hunter [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] found and captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].

When the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] returned to Wasskah, Tano and the other captured [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were released onto a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Island Four/Legends|island]] and became open game for the Trandoshans. During the hunting spree, Krix was sent in a [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|hover pod]] to retrieve the hunter [[Smug/Legends|Smug]], who had been hunting Tano and several other Jedi. However, the pickup was a trap, and Tano and her allies knocked Krix out and hijacked his hover pod. The Jedi brought the fight to Garnac's [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|fortress]] and the guild was summarily fragmented with Garnac's death. Krix later made his way to the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Biography==
===Hunter's paradise===
{{Quote|The sun has risen. Let the hunt begin.|Garnac declares the new hunt|<ref name="PadLost" />}}
[[File:Krix_Lagon_Garnac_and_Dar.png|thumb|left|250px|Krix and Lagon pilot the Reugeot freighter]]
Krix was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunter]] that was a member of a [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|hunting guild]]&mdash;led the Trandoshan [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]]&mdash;that captured both [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient prey to hunt for sport on the<ref name="PadLost" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/padawan-lost-episode-guide|text="Padawan Lost" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> Krix served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and had access to the guild's<ref name="PadLost" /> [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]].<ref name="FactFile-Freighter">{{FactFile2014|30|HUN 1-2|Trandoshan Hunt Ships}}</ref>

During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 13: Chewbacca">{{FactFile2014|13|CHE 1-6|Chewbacca}} dates the events of "[[Wookiee Hunt]]," snf by extension "[[Padawan Lost]]," to [[21 BBY]].</ref> Krix co-piloted the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] alongside fellow Trandoshan [[Lagon/Legends|Lagon]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of potential prey. Accompanying the pilots were Garnac, his son [[Dar/Legends|Dar]], and the hunter [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]]. During their travels they captured a slew of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], including the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Vadoo/Legends|Vadoo]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Morgo/Legends|Morgo]], the [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian Jango Jumper]] [[Lika/Legends|Lika]], and the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Katt Mol/Legends|Katt Mol]].<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide" /> Eventually, Krix and Lagon flew the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], which at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was hosting a [[Second Battle of Felucia|battle]] being fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a part of the on-going [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] conflict.<ref name="PadLost" />

The pilots landed the ship within the Felucian [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] and Lo-Taren disembarked alone. When Lo-Taren returned, he had the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in tow, who had been captured while fighting in the battle. In the presence of Krix, Lo-Taren and Garnac expressed interest in making Tano Dar's first trophy for his debut hunt.<ref name="PadLost" />

The Trandoshans departed Felucia and returned to Wasskah where, under Garnac's orders, Krix and Lagon piloted the ship to [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]]. The prisoners were dumped on the jungle island's [[Beach/Legends|beach]] and Lo-Taren opened fire on them, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Vadoo and Morgo. The survivors fled into the island's jungle.<ref name="PadLost" />

===Cat and mouse===
{{Quote|Krix and Smug should be back by now.|Lagon|<ref name="WookHunt" />}}
The next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Krix was present in the guild's [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|floating fortress's]] trophy room when Garnac officially declared the beginning of the next hunt. Krix and the other Trandoshans adopted arms before heading to Wasskah's surface to hunt. After the day's hunt came to a close, the Trandoshans reconvened in the trophy room for Dar's initiation ceremony, which saw Dar inducted as an official member of the guild. However, Dar was killed the next day by Tano, his intended first kill.<ref name="PadLost" />

Sometime later, Tano, alongside two other Jedi prisoners she had made allies out of, managed to destroy the Reugeot freighter and crash it on Island Four's beach, freeing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] prisoner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and killing the pilots [[Goron/Legends|Goron]] and [[Clutch/Legends|Clutch]] in the process. Krix and the other hunters investigated the crash the following morning, and Krix helped [[Ratter/Legends|Ratter]] pull Clutch's body from the ship's wreckage. Later in the day, the hunter [[Smug/Legends|Smug]] ventured to the crash site to gun Tano and her friends down if they happened to return to the crash to scavenge parts.<ref name="WookHunt" />

[[File:Krix_on_Nal_Hutta.png|thumb|right|250px|Krix, while on Nal Hutta]]
Smug contacted Lo-Taren the next day to request a pickup, and Krix was sent to the crash site to retrieve his comrade. However, the call was a trap, as Smug had been captured and influenced by a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] into calling a ride. Krix's<ref name="WookHunt" /> [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod/Legends|MSP80 Pteropter hover pod]]<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide" /> was ambushed by the Jedi, and Krix was knocked unconscious by Chewbacca after a short struggle with Tano.<ref name="WookHunt" />

Tano and her allies used the hover pod to [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|attack Garnac's fortress directly]] and, with the help of Wookiee reinforcements, the guild was violently dismantled leaving Krix, Smug,<ref name="WookHunt" /> and the hunter [[Ramy/Legends|Ramy]] as the only Trandoshan survivors. Krix and Ramy later left Wasskah and ended up on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where they mingled with the populace of the [[Bilbousa Bazaar/Legends|Bilbousa Bazaar]]. At some point Krix held a conversation with a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] near a [[Bilbousa saloon/Legends|Bilbousa saloon]].<ref name="FaE">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Dar! Dar! Dar!|Krix and the other hunters chant Dar's name|<ref name="WookHunt" />}}
Krix was a burly Trandoshan with [[Color/Legends|cream-and-blue-colored]] scales and orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="WookHunt" /> During Dar's initiation ceremony, Krix displayed a level of excitement as Dar officially joined the guild.<ref name="PadLost" /> When confronted with Padawan Tano during the hijacking of his hover pod, Krix attempted to fight back, but was visibly intimidated by Chewbacca when the Wookiee stepped between them.<ref name="WookHunt" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|We'll take this new batch to Island Four.|Garnac instructs Krix and Lagon on where to pilot the Reugeot freighter|<ref name="PadLost" />}}
As one of the hunting guild's pilots, Krix flew both the guild's Reugeot freighter<ref name="PadLost" /> and one of its hover pods.<ref name="WookHunt" /> Krix armed himself with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] at the dawn of the Tano hunt, but dismissed the weapon by the time he boarded a hover pod.<ref name="PadLost" />

Krix wore dark colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] during the Tano hunt which was accented by bright yellow markings on his shirt, pouches, and combat trousers, which included yellow lightning bolts on his sleeves. He wore grey pants held up by a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with further pouches and set of tactical suspenders sewed on to it, and he a [[Holster/Legends|holster]] strapped to his leg. An electronically powered [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] was wrapped around his left [[Limb/Legends|wrist]] along with a yellow and dark blue armband on his left arm. Another pouch was strapped to his right arm.<ref name="WookHunt" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Krix_Concept_Art.png|thumb|right|250px|Conceptual artwork of Krix for "Padawan Lost"]]
Krix was one several Trandoshan characters introduced in "[[Padawan Lost]]," the twenty-first episode episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide" /> However, Krix was not identified by name until the<ref name="WookHunt" /> following episode,<ref name="Wookiee Hunt Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/wookiee-hunt-episode-guide|text="Wookiee Hunt" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> "[[Wookiee Hunt]]."<ref name="WookHunt" /> Both episodes aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]] as a part of Season Three's finale.<ref name="Air Dates">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Krix later appear in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Season Four]] episode "[[Friends and Enemies]],"<ref name="Explore: Friends and Enemies">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep416|text="Friends and Enemies" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> which aired on [[January 27]], [[2012]].<ref name="Air Dates" />

Like all of the Trandoshans that appeared in the episodes, Krix was designed by artist [[Pat Presley]]. Krix's stocky build was created out of a need for diverse body types among the Trandoshans in order to differentiate them from the previously seen Trandoshan character [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]].<ref name="Season 3">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]</ref> Conceptual art depicting Krix showed the character with yellow eyes,<ref name="Padawan Lost Ep Guide" /> which in the episodes were changed to orange.<ref name="PadLost" /><ref name="WookHunt" /> Krix's name was chosen because, according to series head [[Dave Filoni]], it sounded lizard-like.<ref name="Season 3" />
